S.TRANSL: Firstly, wash sticky rice with water,

FORM.notes: source note: IU3 rbegun 'soak into water以水浸泡' is related to rmebu, rbegi, rbegun, rbegan, runbegan/rnbegan 'things that are soaked/water that is used for washing rice泡過之物；洗米水'。 | source note: sino bale is also called sino seediq. Its original name was qnepu. Qnepu refers to filtrated liquid. / sino bale 又稱sino seediq, 其實它最初的稱謂是 qnepu. Qnepu是「經篩子過濾之液體」的意思。

S.FORM: ma rebuun a ani naq Lsanjikang.
S.PHON: ma ɾebuun a ani naq lsanjikaŋ
S.FORM: ma rebuun a ani naq Lsanjikang.
S.PHON: ma ɾebuun a ani naq lsanjikaŋ
S.TRANSL: 接著將洗過的糯米浸泡在水中約三小時,
then soak the washed sticky rice into water for three hours.
After soaking sticky rice into water,

FORM.notes: source note: IU7 hlmaun is from hlama 'sticky rice/cake (noun) 糯米飯、糖果（名詞）', hmlama 'steam sticky rice (verb) 蒸煮糯米飯（動詞）'. Other forms are hlmai, hlmaun, hlmaan. | source note: Seediq steam box (蒸桶) is made by Firmiana simplex梧桐. | source note: duhung 'mortar 臼', seru 'mallet杵'. They are made of tgebin ' zelkova tree櫸木'.

S.TRANSL: you use steaming box to steam the sticky rice.

FORM.notes: source note: IU8 Mahada means 'mature (fruit)', 'cooked well', and 'boiled well' | source note: IU8 prayun is from pure 'cook煮飯'. Other forms are prai, prayun/praun, prayan/praan, hpurai, hprayun, hprayan, hnprayan 'cooked food', sapah pprayan 'kitchen廚房'.

S.TRANSL: you use fire to steam up.
After the sticky rice steamed well,

FORM.notes: source note: IU11 pkruun is from pkeru/mkeru 'pour倒入'. Other forms are pkrui 'ask someone to pour', pkruun, pkruan, kpurui 'pour: speakers action'.
source note: IU12 in pkruun, p is almost inaudible.

source note: IU13 mtilux 'heat up' | source note: IU13 tleetu 'room temperature 指常溫的溫度' Tltei 'put something hot in room temparature to make it cool down將熱的物品冷卻'. Other forms are tlteun, tltean, tleetu.

S.TRANSL: When the sticky rice cools down to room temperature,
就灑上酒麴(要攪拌均勻),
you put malted rice (it should be mixed evenly).

FORM.notes: source note: IU16 tmamun 'put malted rice into something 以酒麴混入某物' tamun 'malted rice (noun)/酒麴（名詞）' or 'Mallotus paniculatus白匏樹'.
source note: IU18 bungun 'cover蓋住'is related to mubung, bungi, bungun, bungan.

S.FORM: m a mhedusu tmamun de ubungunsu di ma kika.
S.PHON: m a mħedusu tmamun de ubuŋunsu di ma kika
S.FORM: m a mhedusu tmamun de ubungunsu di ma kika.
S.PHON: m a mħedusu tmamun de ubuŋunsu di ma kika
S.TRANSL: 妳將糯米飯與酒麴混合均勻後,妳就把它蓋起來...那麼(接下來),
After you mix the sticky rice and koji evenly, you cover it up, then,

FORM.notes: source note: IU21 mkdaha 'after two days 經過兩天', mksepac 'after four days經過四天',

S.TRANSL: 過了三天(因酒麴發酵)糯米飯會發熱,
after three days (due to catalysis), sticky rice become heated.

FORM.notes: source note: IU22 ngalun 'take取拿'is related to mangan, ngali, ngalun, ngalan | source note: IU22 psaun 'put放置' is related to paha, psai, psaun, psaan.

S.FORM: ngalunsu du ma posaunsu salo di.

S.FORM: ngalunsu du ma posaunsu salo di.
S.PHON: ŋalunsu du ma posaunsu salo di
S.TRANSL: So, put it inside salo (a kind of container).

FORM.notes: source note: IU24 she is probably making a gesture explaining that water should be poured until certain point.

S.FORM: salo ma posaun qsiya di ma posaun biciq qsiya wa posaun betaq bale hini qsiya.
S.PHON: salo ma posaun qsija di ma posaun biʦiq qsija wa posaun betaq bale ħini qsija
S.FORM: salo ma posaun qsiya di ma posaun biciq qsiya wa posaun betaq bale hini qsiya.
S.PHON: salo ma posaun qsija di ma posaun biʦiq qsija wa posaun betaq bale ħini qsija
S.TRANSL: (已發酵的糯米飯置入容器中時)加少許的水,只能加水到這裡,
(When you put steamed rice into a container), pour a little water, only up to here.

FORM.notes: source note: IU25 gmegang 'mix攪拌' is related to ggami, ggamun, ggaman.
source note: IU27 gmuki 'cover蓋住' is related to gmemuk, gmukun, gmukan.
